description: Customers could not pay by card. payment-service logged massive PayGate timeouts starting around 12:05 UTC. Other metrics were normal.
The /payments/create endpoint took 5-7 seconds. Database CPU was high and reporting-service ran long queries. api-gateway returned 504 errors.
Top-up confirmation e-mails were not delivered although balances were correct. notification-service logged intermittent SMTP connection errors.
Some mobile users could not log in. auth-service returned 401 and logged invalid token signatures. Other services had no large-scale failures.
